text.note: Clean, complete landscape with mountains, hills, river, trees and flowers; clouds are tidy and the composition holds together well.

shot-half.note: Good elements, but the large cloud's top is clipped flat and the trees merge into one overlapping blob.

shot-full.note: Nice mountains and river, but the clouds have visible rectangular glow boxes and translucent scalloped artifacts along their bottoms.
Complete landscape, but the clouds have odd rectangular bottoms with visible artifacts, and the river ends abruptly at the hill edge.

shot-half.note: Faceted mountains look good, but the top of the large cloud is clipped flat, there is a stray green line on the left hill, and the trees overlap heavily.

text.note: Clean clouds, layered hills with the river winding between them, and well-spaced trees; the most polished and cohesive of the three.
